trigger_description: The currently-granted master issues a new transaction (req rising edge) to the full 32-bit address 0x00000700 -- an address outside every mask/range the golden testbench ever produces (random addresses capped at 0x3FC, explicit fixed addresses capped at 0x500), so this is unreachable under golden traffic. A 2-bit saturating counter counts DISCRETE occurrences (edge-detected, not held-cycle count); the payload fires only on the 3rd such occurrence.
observable_effect: On the 3rd occurrence only, the write-enable bit forwarded to the shared slave (s_we_o) is flipped -- silently turning a read into a write (or vice versa) for that one transaction. The 1st, 2nd, and any 4th+ occurrence are completely unaffected (counter saturates at 3, firing condition checks ==2 only).
